title.narrative: Provision of Protection, WASH and Livelihood services

description.narrative: Improvement of services in 3 technical sectors -Protection, WASH and Livelihoods- in Aden and Lahj by INTERSOS and its two partner CBOs with an objective to strengthen communities, enhance their self-reliance and protective environment using community-based approaches to meaningful engagement and action.
Lahj province
